agent_explanation: Single ball dropped from y=3.4 hits floor between step 24-25 with e=1. With large dt~0.0308 and 8 substeps, the impulse + positional correction on floor collision adds energy: speed magnitude increases from 7.25 (pre-bounce, step24) to 8.62 (post-bounce, step25) instead of conserving, raising total energy from ~32.95 to 42.34, exceeding allowed 41.689. Lowering e to 0.9 removes net gain, proving restitution handling at large dt is cause.
